newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers quotes far apart, demand average.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers quotes far apart, demand average.

text.p: Singapore bunkers indications were far apart on Thursday, but were around Wednesday's range, traders said.

Bunker 180-cst was offered at $124 by a major with an independent offering $126. Bunker 380-cst was asked at $120 by majors, while an independent offered was at $121. Lower indications were between $118 and $119.

A shipowner said prices have been rangebound and were not expected to move higher. The same shipowner is covering demand from Fujairah and Hong Kong where prices were reported to be slightly higher. --Singapore Newsroom(+65-8703082)
